user.title: Connect a VIZIO TV
user.description: Enter the TV host and choose a name. Home Assistant will ask the TV to display a pairing PIN.

pin.title: Enter the VIZIO pairing PIN
pin.description: Read the PIN shown on the TV and enter it here. The PIN is used once and is not stored.

error.invalid_host: Enter a host and port without spaces.
error.cannot_connect: Could not start pairing with the TV.
error.invalid_pin: The TV rejected that PIN. Check the TV and try again.
